name: FAIRsharing
license_or_terms: FAIRsharing content is CC BY-SA 4.0; check current API access and reuse terms before bulk harvesting.
notes: Community-curated interlinked records for databases/repositories, standards and policies. It describes and relates resources but does not host their datasets. Web records and API/schema documentation are available; this review did not execute full or authenticated GraphQL queries.

name: re3data
query_modes: web_search|faceted browse|REST API v4|daily XML export
license_or_terms: Repository metadata released CC0; underlying repository data follow their own terms.
notes: Indexes research data repositories rather than individual datasets, studies, samples or reads. API v4.0 provides repository index and detail endpoints; the site also publishes daily XML exports of online repositories. Use it to find a suitable repository, then search that repository for microbiome projects/accessions.

name: bio.tools
license_or_terms: Registry access and metadata reuse follow bio.tools terms; individual tools retain their own licenses.
notes: ELIXIR-backed registry of life-science software, services and computational resources, including databases. Public read API supports paginated listing, free-text search, attribute filters and individual tool records; create/update operations require authentication. It catalogs tools but does not execute them or host their data.

name: NAR Molecular Biology Database Collection
aliases: NAR Database Issue|Online Molecular Biology Database Collection
omics_types: database descriptions and annual update papers
license_or_terms: Open-access article and collection links; each linked resource has its own license and access terms.
notes: Cross-disciplinary route for discovering database papers and annual resource updates, not a microbiome-only index or data host. The 2026 overview reports 2,173 Collection entries after reviewing 899 entries, adding 96 and removing 319 discontinued URLs over the prior year; these are article-reported snapshot counts, not a live availability guarantee.

name: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA)
notes: Official SRA model separates Study, Sample, Experiment and Run; technical metadata primarily appears at Experiment/Run levels.

name: NCBI BioSample
notes: Sample attributes are submitter-provided; per-record field completeness varies.

name: NCBI BioProject
notes: Useful for project-level context and linked records; project-level descriptions should not be assigned to individual samples.

name: European Nucleotide Archive (ENA)
notes: Programmatic search and linked record retrieval; linked to INSDC archives.

name: DDBJ Sequence Read Archive
notes: Official DRA download guide and getentry documentation checked; DRA file retrieval uses DDBJ Search, not getentry.

name: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
discovery_sources: FAIRsharing|re3data|bio.tools|NAR database issue|2026 human gut resource review
notes: Official GEO documentation confirms search by study/accession/metadata and public downloads; high-throughput sequencing raw reads are brokered to SRA, while processed files and supplementary materials remain linked to GEO records. GEO is a broad functional-genomics archive, not a dedicated microbiome community-sequencing archive.

name: EMBL-EBI BioStudies
notes: Official EMBL-EBI documentation confirms search by accession, publication, keyword or metadata; REST API supports cursor-paginated search and study-detail retrieval. BioStudies links external archive records and hosts unstructured study/supplementary files. Some records may be held until publication or otherwise access-controlled; not a microbiome-specific archive.

name: Europe PMC
notes: Official REST API documents article search and programmatic access; useful for publication and accession mentions, but does not establish sample-level crosswalks.

name: PMC BioC Supplementary Materials
notes: Coverage is limited to PMC Open Access supplementary material; file formats may limit table preservation.

name: MGnify
notes: Current documented API is v2 and covers studies, samples, runs, biomes and analyses. API v1 was deprecated in 2026-06 and is frozen; documentation says shutdown no earlier than 2026-09-01. ENA-derived records, analyses and some contextual/publication annotations remain source-specific; publication annotations are not reliably attributable to individual samples.

name: MG-RAST
notes: Official REST API runtime check on 2026-11-10: GET /1/metagenome/mgm4440026.3?verbosity=full returned HTTP 200 JSON including linked sample metadata. A public search query using limit=2 returned HTTP 200 but total_count=0; query filters and coverage still need calibration. Public records are queryable without a key; private records need authorization. MG-RAST-native IDs do not make it a universal resolver for arbitrary SRA/ENA accessions.

name: Qiita
notes: Official documentation confirms a core browse, metadata-download, or query capability. This status does not imply arbitrary accession-to-subject crosswalk coverage. Official 2026.01 docs separate biological sample information from preparation/sequencing metadata and document public sample-metadata downloads. The REST documentation labels the general study/sample API as internal and planned for external use; do not depend on it as a public query API. Study permissions are controlled by their owners, and Qiita IDs do not guarantee a match to every archive accession.

name: Microbiome Repo
license_or_terms: Check release-level terms before redistributing tables; local catalog stores links only.
notes: Official release R2026.36 / data package 1.30.0 (2026-11-06): curated catalog reports 5,052 projects and 806,054 sample records. Per-field claims include source route, confidence and evidence; sample sheet API is project-scoped. The registry and curated catalog have different scope/counts. Sample records are not participant counts. This resource covers human-associated shotgun DNA/RNA and is not all-assay coverage.

name: curatedMetagenomicData
notes: cMD 3 paper reports 22,588 samples across 93 datasets in the package; paper analysis includes one additional 122-sample study (22,710 total across 94 cohorts). Manually curated and machine-validated metadata across 100+ participant characteristics; per-field coverage varies. Not a universal accession resolver; record release and cohort mapping.

name: GMrepo v3
notes: The 2026 v3 paper describes curated metadata, taxonomic profiles and marker downloads; official usage documentation describes sample/run lookup and downloadable project metadata. The current portal could not be interactively inspected here, so verify version-specific units and mappings before reuse.

name: GutBiomeDB
notes: 2026-11-05 paper describes 168,464 human gut 16S samples from 482 BioProjects, manually curated disease, life-stage/age, sex and geographic fields; taxonomic profiles and metadata are downloadable from Zenodo. Paper reports 46 public REST endpoints; base URL/schema were not independently documented in this catalog. Not a broad body-site, shotgun, diet or full clinical-metadata source.

name: PRIME
license_or_terms: Paper states files are available for academic use under MIT; check current terms for each data file and redistribution.
notes: 2026 NAR paper reports 53,449 sample records from 111 human-associated 16S studies, covering 93 body sites and 101 phenotype categories. Manually curated sample-level metadata and taxonomic profiles (SILVA 138.2 and Greengenes2 2024.09); web, REST API v1, and primeDB R client. Counts are sample records, not participants; profile-derived or study-level fields still require original-source/crosswalk review.

name: Metalog
notes: NAR 2026 paper documents metadata-field/sample browsing, multi-field filtering, whole-database or per-study downloads, and links to publications/sequence records. The site returned an anti-bot denial in this check, so live UI and exact download files were not exercised. Curated coverage is not exhaustive; amplicon and metatranscriptomic data are excluded.

name: MiCoDa
license_or_terms: Official page indicates Creative Commons 4.0 International; verify the exact license variant and subset terms before redistribution.
notes: Curated/reprocessed global 16S V4 data (region 515–806), including EMP and other collections. Raw reads are linked to INSDC accessions; additional technical metadata such as sequencer and extraction kit are collected from publications. The live page shows version/collection-dependent counts; do not treat them as unique participants or directly compare across releases.

name: HumanMetagenomeDB
accepted_ids: SRA/ENA sample and run IDs (paper-described links)
notes: Current official portal exposes quick/advanced filters, a world map, CSV export and raw-sequence download links; it reports Release 1.1 (June 2020) with 69,822 curated human metagenomes. Filters include host age and BMI. This is an accessible but dated, fixed release; verify source accession crosswalk and counts before reuse.

name: mBodyMap
discovery_sources: Metalog 2025 resource overview|NAR database issue|2026 human gut resource review
notes: The NAR 2022 paper documents body-site/disease browsing, downloadable curated project and sample/run metadata, and host age, sex, country, BMI and disease annotations. It reports 63,148 runs across 136 projects and 22 body sites as that paper's snapshot; current site resolves but present counts and ID crosswalks were not re-audited.

name: Meta2DB
notes: Zenodo v1 record lists downloadable metadata CSV, field definitions, taxonomy profiles and feature data; it reports 13,897 samples across 84 studies, 23 disease states and 34 locations. Human shotgun feature/metadata compendium, not a universal accession resolver; license field is not stated on the record.

name: gutDBase
notes: The 2026 NAR article documents browse by disease/data type, queries for differential genes/taxa, and downloads of processed profiles/results. It integrates 175 datasets from 161 studies across 15 gut diseases, including host-microbe associations. Sample-level accession crosswalks and license were not audited; this is a focused multi-omics resource, not an archive resolver.

name: AncientMetagenomeDir
license_or_terms: CC-BY-4.0
notes: Community-curated tables index published ancient metagenome samples and sequencing libraries, with publication, sample type, geography, date and source-archive accessions; GitHub documents a website/map, versioned Zenodo releases and CC BY 4.0. It is a lightweight discovery index, not a complete phenotype database; release recency and completeness should be checked.

name: MarineMetagenomeDB
notes: Official site exposes search, filters and CSV/raw-read download workflows. Release 1.0 (June 2021) reports 11,449 marine metagenomes from SRA and MG-RAST; not an exhaustive/current archive.

name: TerrestrialMetagenomeDB
notes: Official site exposes filters and CSV download. Release 2.0 (January 2021) reports 20,206 terrestrial metagenomes; curated environmental metadata and version are dated, so check release/currentness before analysis.

name: Animal Microbiome Database
notes: The 2022 NAR paper documents a curated database of 2,530 animal-gut 16S samples across 34 projects with host taxonomy, diet/trophic group and gut metadata. The first-party portal timed out on 2026-11-10; retain as a published historical resource and recheck availability before use.

name: AnimalMetagenome DB
discovery_sources: 2023 database review|Scientific Data 2022 paper|Figshare dataset record
notes: The 2022 paper documents browse/search/download and an open Figshare release containing 82,097 animal metagenome records with project, sample, experiment and PubMed links. The former portal could not be reached during this check; verified access is through the archived dataset DOI, not a current interactive resolver.

name: AnimalAssociatedMetagenomeDB
notes: Official portal documents quick/advanced search, map selection, CSV metadata export and raw-read download. Release 1.0 (October 2021) contains 10,885 animal-associated metagenomes; these are animal-associated, not necessarily host-derived, and the release is dated. Per-record accessions should be checked before use.

name: Murine Microbiome Database
notes: The 2019 paper describes 554 healthy mouse 16S samples from 14 projects with curated metadata for GI location, genotype and vendor. The listed portal timed out on 2026-11-10; retain as a published historical resource, not a confirmed current service.

name: Human Microbiome Compendium
license_or_terms: CC BY
notes: Zenodo current release v1.1.2 was published 2026-08-20 and includes sample_metadata.tsv, projects.csv, classifications and profiles under CC BY 4.0; project portal describes an ongoing uniform human gut 16S compendium. Fixed versioned dataset, not a live accession resolver.

name: MicrobiomeDB
notes: Official about page describes querying study/sample metadata mapped to MIxS with a custom ontology and visualizing taxon abundances. Site news reports MicrobiomeDB 37 (2024-05) added 93 shotgun studies (>22,000 samples); at this check the app shell loaded but study-table initialization failed, so current browse/query behavior and API remain partly unverified.

name: African Human Microbiome Portal
license_or_terms: Check source-study terms
notes: Current H3ABioNet portal provides Boolean metadata search, downloadable overview panels, a map and data download; its page reports 70 BioProjects and 14,889 BioSamples at this check. It is specifically focused on African human microbiome studies. Field completeness and per-sample accession mapping should be confirmed in downloads.

name: Human Microbiome Project Data Portal
license_or_terms: Data/resource-specific terms; controlled human data follow dbGaP/repository rules
notes: The current HMPDACC site provides a searchable/filterable data catalog, S3 paths and download commands; public HMP/iHMP products and BioProjects were confirmed available on 2026-07-27. Raw reads are often in SRA; detailed participant phenotypes and some human sequence data remain controlled through dbGaP/repositories. The former portal.hmpdacc.org URL is a legacy JavaScript shell.

name: MetaSRA
notes: Official API documents sample/term queries, ontology-based filtering, JSON/CSV sample and run exports, and SRA sample→experiment→run links; latest listed snapshot v1.8 is 2020-11-11. Scope is principally human/mouse RNA-seq and ChIP-seq, not 16S or shotgun microbiome; include as a metadata-normalization method reference, not a microbiome data source.

name: MetaHQ
assays: RNA-seq|microarray and other indexed public omics
accepted_ids: GEO sample/series IDs; SRA IDs included in annotation metadata
license_or_terms: Annotation database CC BY-NC 4.0; CLI BSD-3-Clause; source-specific terms apply
discovery_sources: FAIRsharing|re3data|bio.tools|NAR database issue|prior resource review|official GitHub|Zenodo
notes: MetaHQ combines annotations from searchable databases, project sites, repositories and publication supplements; its CLI retrieves tissue, disease, sex and age annotations with sample/series level, evidence-source and license filters. The September 2026 Zenodo record is v1.2.0-rc1. It is a general omics metadata resource rather than a microbiome-specific database; the preprint is not peer-reviewed, and the annotation database is CC BY-NC 4.0.

name: Disbiome
discovery_sources: H3ABioNet microbiome resource index|2026 human gut resource review|official site|primary_paper
notes: Official site/help documents disease, organism, detection-method and experiment searches. Public experiment JSON API runtime check on 2026-11-10 returned HTTP 200 and experiment association records; disease endpoint also returned HTTP 200. This is a curated disease-microbe association knowledgebase, not a sample accession resolver or sample-level host phenotype source.

name: gutMDisorder
notes: Official documentation confirms a core browse, metadata-download, or query capability. This status does not imply arbitrary accession-to-subject crosswalk coverage. The official site describes literature-based and raw-data-based human and mouse associations, with gut/oral source, phenotype and intervention categories including diet/food/nutrition. Its release history reports v3.0 on 2026-06-10. Current interface and sample-level identifier crosswalk have not been exercised; this is an association knowledgebase, not a general accession resolver.

name: gutMGene v2.0
license_or_terms: All rights reserved
discovery_sources: Human gut microbiome resource review 2026|NAR database issue 2025|official_site
notes: The NAR 2025 paper documents browse/search/retrieval of curated gut microbe–metabolite–host gene associations and evidence details. This is an association knowledgebase, not a sequencing sample repository. The record states all rights reserved; direct current UI and data reuse terms remain to check.

name: Expanded Human Oral Microbiome Database (eHOMD)
license_or_terms: Check resource-specific reuse terms
discovery_sources: H3ABioNet microbiome resource index|2023 database review|official site
notes: Official site reports eHOMD v4.3 and provides taxonomy/genome tables, oral/aerodigestive site annotations, 16S RefSeq download and BLAST. It is a microbial reference knowledgebase, not a host cohort or sample-metadata archive.

name: BugSigDB
metadata_domains: disease|taxon|direction of association|study design|host body site|experimental methods
license_or_terms: Check dataset license and citation terms
discovery_sources: Microbiome Repo sources and related literature|official site|primary_paper
notes: Current official BugSigDB pages document curated study/experiment/signature records with study design, body site, health outcome and methods; data can be exported and accessed through the bugsigdbr R/Bioconductor package. These are literature-derived differential-abundance signatures, not raw samples or accession-level metadata.

name: Human OncoBiome Database
notes: The 2020 paper describes a searchable manually curated cancer-microbiome dataset database, and H3ABioNet continues to list the project. A current first-party endpoint or data release could not be located; retain as a historical resource lead, not a confirmed current service.

name: NIBN Japan Microbiome Database
discovery_sources: Scientific Reports 2025 paper|official database page|official access notice|2026 human gut resource review
notes: Official public-version portal lists selectable sample IDs, age, sex, sampling month and available assays; full sample browsing requires account registration since 2026-02-05. Official page reports 4,578 16S and 4,302 shotgun records overall; public release reports 2,273 samples/2,068 participants across nine regions with region, age, sex, diet and nutrient metadata. Some detailed phenotype data require approved collaboration. NIBN IDs may not map to INSDC BioSample IDs without a crosswalk.

name: GIMICA
license_or_terms: All rights reserved
discovery_sources: Human gut microbiome resource review 2026|NAR database issue 2021|official_site
notes: Official download page provides files for host-factor-shaped microbiota and microbe, genetic-factor, immune-factor and disease tables; last updated 2020-11-20, all rights reserved. It is a dated association knowledgebase, not per-sample sequencing metadata.

name: gcMeta
discovery_sources: NAR database issue 2026|official_site|2026 human gut microbiome resource review
notes: 2025 release describes >2.7 million MAGs from 104,266 samples across 50 biome catalogues, linked to NCBI BioSamples; offers downloadable catalogues and AI-ready data. This is primarily a MAG/functional resource, not a host phenotype recovery service.

name: MicrobiomeHD
license_or_terms: Zenodo dataset record; cite source paper and dataset
notes: Fixed standardized collection of public human gut 16S case-control studies, metadata and profiles; Zenodo record provides data. The GitHub repository was archived on 2023-09-27, so treat as a historical analysis dataset rather than a maintained query service.

name: MicrobeAtlas
notes: Official Sample Groups page advertises project/sample-group exploration and downloads; the site and 2026 Cell paper describe sample, project, publication and taxonomy context. Download schema and individual accession lookups were not tested. Environmental and microbial-ecology focus; not a host clinical phenotype service.

name: MAMI (Microbiome Atlas of Mothers and Infants)
aliases: Microbiome Atlas of Mothers and Infants
ecosystem_or_body_sites: maternal gut|skin|nasal cavity|oral cavity|vagina|breast milk|infant gut|skin|nasal cavity|oral cavity
license_or_terms: See portal terms; verify per underlying dataset
notes: Curated maternal/neonatal microbiome and probiotic resource. Portal exposes accession lists and abundance tables grouped by maternal/infant category and body site. Publication describes six maternal and four neonatal body sites and temporal information. This is a focused curated atlas, not a universal ID-to-metadata resolver; field coverage and sample-level crosswalk vary by underlying study.

name: European Genome-phenome Archive (EGA)
license_or_terms: Public metadata; controlled datasets require DAC approval and access agreement
notes: General human data archive relevant when microbiome-linked clinical/questionnaire metadata or reads are controlled. Public metadata API supports study/dataset/sample/run and cross-querying; sensitive data requires application to the relevant Data Access Committee. Example Lifelines NEXT pairs public SRA reads with controlled EGA phenotype metadata.

name: NCBI Database of Genotypes and Phenotypes (dbGaP)
license_or_terms: Controlled individual-level data require DAC approval and Data Use Certification
notes: Public pages expose study summaries, variable descriptions, and documents. Individual-level phenotypes and genotypes are controlled by study-specific DACs. The submission schema includes Subject Sample Mapping (SSM) linking subjects to submitted samples; availability of a specific mapping must be checked per study.

name: National Microbiome Data Collaborative (NMDC)
aliases: NMDC Data Portal|National Microbiome Data Collaborative
accepted_ids: NMDC study ID|NMDC biosample ID|data object ID
license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0; ORCID login required for portal downloads
notes: Environmental microbiome resource with curated biosample metadata, standardized multi-omics workflows, data portal, and REST API for studies/biosamples/data objects. NMDC explicitly does not support human microbiome data. Public data are attributed under CC BY 4.0; ORCID login is required for portal downloads. API version observed in this check: 2.20.0.

name: Genomes OnLine Database (GOLD)
accepted_ids: GOLD study ID|biosample ID|sequencing project ID|analysis project ID
license_or_terms: See resource and dataset-specific terms
notes: JGI-maintained project and biosample metadata registry spanning genome and metagenome projects, with ecosystem classification and searchable project/sample records. GOLD metadata are also used by IMG/M. It is a microbial/ecological project registry, not a general human clinical phenotype archive.

name: IMG/M (Integrated Microbial Genomes and Microbiomes)
accepted_ids: IMG metagenome ID|IMG genome ID|GOLD study ID|GOLD sequencing project ID
license_or_terms: See JGI data portal terms and dataset-specific conditions
notes: Official help page exposes genome/metagenome search and links to sequence/annotation and bulk-download routes; GOLD is the source for sample metadata. Useful for microbial/ecosystem context and functional analysis, not host clinical metadata. Data-use policy and dataset-specific access terms apply; per-record routes were not tested.

name: JGI Data Portal
omics_types: genomic data files|metagenomic data files|file metadata
license_or_terms: Public data; retrieval may require login and queued archive requests
notes: Current JGI portal for searching metadata associated with public genome/metagenome files and retrieving files via browser, Globus, CLI, or API. API documentation requires logging into the Data Portal; data can reside in tape archive and require a retrieval request. JGI states the former Genome Portal was replaced and sunset in 2026.

name: SPIRE
query_modes: web search|sample and habitat browsing|taxonomy browsing|bulk download
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Version 1 paper reports 99,146 consistently processed shotgun metagenomic samples from 739 studies; contextual annotations are sourced from ENA, IMG/M where available, and matched publications, then manually tagged with a 92-term microntology. Current interface and individual accession lookup were not exercised in this check.

name: Ocean-M
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. The 2025 paper describes marine multi-omics integration with environmental metadata and 54,083 high-quality MAGs; the current site displays a 57,288-dataset count and a Sample Search entry. Host context here means marine host/ecology associations, not human clinical metadata. Search and download workflows were not exercised.

name: MRGM (Mouse Reference Gut Microbiome)
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Official page reports 42,245 nonredundant genomes across 1,524 prokaryotic species and a nonredundant protein catalog, with custom Kraken2 and MetaPhlAn databases. It is a mouse gut genome/taxonomy reference, not a source of individual animal age, diet, health, or sample crosswalk metadata.

name: MOMD (Mouse Oral Microbiome Database)
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Official site describes 205 Mouse Oral Taxa and reference 16S sequences, draft genomes, annotation browsing and BLAST tools. Useful for mouse oral microbiology and taxonomic interpretation; does not provide a general cohort sample table or host phenotype crosswalk.

name: HRGM2 (Human Reference Gut Microbiome v2)
license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Official page describes 155,211 nonredundant near-complete genomes from 4,824 species assembled from 18,111 WMS samples across 41 countries, with browse/download and Zenodo links. Geographic coverage is dataset provenance, not per-sample participant demographics; this is a genome reference catalog, not a clinical metadata service.

name: ResMicroDb
omics_types: standardized taxonomic profiles|curated sample metadata|microbe-disease associations
query_modes: web search|metadata filters|sample/project browse|download|similarity search|cross-study analysis
license_or_terms: See official site terms
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Official help describes 106,464 samples/runs across 514 projects and 489 publications, 10 respiratory sites, 146 phenotypes, and 32 manually curated metadata factors; sample/project pages link project accessions and PMIDs. Public downloads include metadata and abundance tables. The portal was indexed and its help/project pages inspected, but an individual sample accession-to-record lookup was not tested.

name: gutMSNP
metadata_domains: host phenotype|project accession|PMID|sample source|Disease Ontology|sequencing platform|sample count
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. The paper reports 164,015,783 SNPs from 4,386 human gut metagenomic samples across 21 phenotypes, with project accession, PMID, sample source, DO term, platform and sample count context; it also catalogs 8,146 representative genomes. Phenotype/sample counts are study-level context and do not establish a public participant-to-BioSample crosswalk.

name: VIRE
license_or_terms: Check release-specific terms
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. The 2026 paper describes >1.7 million medium/high-quality viral genomes recovered from >100,000 metagenomic datasets, spanning host-associated and environmental ecosystems, with integration to SPIRE and Metalog for linked context. It is a virome/genome resource, not a general host clinical metadata repository; current accession search/API behavior was not directly tested.

name: PanGBank
license_or_terms: Data CC BY-SA 4.0; software CeCILL v2.1
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. The initial release contains pangenomes for >4,600 prokaryotic species and >393,000 genomes from GTDB-aligned collections. Useful for comparative genomics and functional variation; it is not a sample-level metadata or host phenotype source. REST API/CLI are documented but not exercised in this review.

name: Online Ancient Genome Repository (OAGR)
ecosystem_or_body_sites: ancient human microbiome; specific sites to verify
omics_types: raw and processed genomic/microbiome data|provenance metadata
license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 in institutional catalog; verify per dataset
discovery_sources: re3data|NLM Dataset Catalog|Research Data Australia|Adelaide University
notes: Research Data Australia/Adelaide University retains a historical OAGR catalog record describing ancient human genome/microbiome data, provenance metadata, a dataset DOI, and CC BY 4.0 (https://researchdata.edu.au/online-ancient-genome-repository/1604205). re3data marks the OAGR repository offline since 2022, and the original landing page is unavailable; the catalog/DOI record does not establish that the repository service or a current dataset inventory remains operational. Not a general microbiome accession resolver.

name: BacDive (Bacterial Diversity Metadatabase)
accepted_ids: BacDive ID|culture collection number|NCBI Tax ID|16S accession
license_or_terms: Check current data terms
notes: Official page/paper confirms at least one core browse, query, or download route; individual accession/sample crosswalk behavior has not been tested. Strain-level knowledgebase with >100,000 bacterial/archaeal strains, >1,000 fields across taxonomy, origin, physiology, cultivation and sequences. API v2 is current and requires no registration from February 2026; API endpoints and per-strain response were not exercised. Can contextualize an identified isolate/strain, but cannot provide human cohort phenotype or BioSample-to-subject mapping.

name: MiMeDB (Human Microbial Metabolome Database)
aliases: Microbial Metabolome Database|Human Microbial Metabolome Database
omics_types: microbiome metabolomics|microbial metabolites|microbial genes and pathways
accepted_ids: MiMeDB internal IDs|microbial taxonomy IDs|linked database identifiers
license_or_terms: Check current data reuse/website terms; paper OA CC BY-NC does not automatically define database license
notes: MiMeDB 2.0 links human-associated microbes and body sites to metabolites, genes/pathways, host health/disease, diet/exposure and spectral information; official site supports text, sequence, spectral, chemical-structure and relational queries. The 2026 paper reports >12.9 million microbial genes, 23.1 million pathways, 29,295 metabolites, 3,725 species/strains and 21,829 reactions. This is a host-associated molecular knowledgebase, not a sequencing sample repository or BioSample crosswalk. Verify database reuse terms independently; the article license is noncommercial and may differ from database data terms.

name: Genome Sequence Archive (CNCB-NGDC)
license_or_terms: Check dataset-level terms and any release/access restrictions
notes: Public raw-read archive organized into BioProject, BioSample, Experiment and Run objects; official sources report integrated INSDC metadata and global search. GSA-owned records and mirrored INSDC records can duplicate the same sequence/sample context; preserve the original provider accession and deduplicate by stable linked IDs. Not an API-confirmed crosswalk for arbitrary host phenotypes.

name: Genome Sequence Archive for Human (GSA-Human)
ecosystem_or_body_sites: human biomedical cohorts|human-associated metagenome study templates
omics_types: raw human sequencing data|host phenotype and study metadata
license_or_terms: Open/controlled access varies; obey DAC, data-use agreement and applicable human-genetic-resource policy
discovery_sources: NAR Database Issue 2026|official site|official access documentation
notes: Human-omics archive uses Study, Individual, Sample, Experiment and Run objects; public metadata visibility and sequence download vary by data sharing status, and controlled records require DAC approval. Its 2025 family paper states that templates include human-associated metagenome studies. Useful for authorized host-level context when a direct identifier link exists; it does not infer a subject-to-BioSample crosswalk for unrelated archives.

name: iMicrobe
accepted_ids: iMicrobe project IDs|iMicrobe sample IDs|linked external accessions
license_or_terms: Check each linked source and CyVerse/iMicrobe terms
notes: The 2019 platform paper and old official docs describe search/broker behavior across >250 metadata fields with externally hosted files. Historical data routes point to the CyVerse Data Commons /iplant/home/shared/imicrobe directory and iMicrobe FTP (https://datacommons.cyverse.org/browse/iplant/home/shared/imicrobe); this check loaded only the Data Commons app shell and did not verify directory contents or file access. Official platform returned HTTP 502 on 2026-11-10; docs are old, and grabseqs v1.0 removed iMicrobe support. Retain as a historical discovery lead; verify any route before use.

name: curatedFoodMetagenomicData (cFMD)
license_or_terms: CC-BY-4.0
notes: Latest release listed by DOMINO is cFMD v1.3.2 (June 2026): 4,125 food metagenomes from 109 datasets and 54 countries, with curated metadata, taxonomic/functional profiles and 18,180 MAGs. Sample-level food context is valuable for food microbiome discovery; it is not a human host phenotype database.

name: FoodMicroDB
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Paper describes 6,358 amplicon samples from 108 projects across 62 foods, with 4,710 taxa, project-sample relationships, curated host-food-organism links and time-series/composition visualization. Food and food-source labels are the primary context; not a human participant metadata source.

name: FoodMicrobionet
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Official project page lists version 5.1.2 with 302 studies, 17,174 bacterial samples and 3,175 fungal samples. Its relational tables link projects, sample descriptions, BioSample/Run IDs, FoodEx2 and publication-derived annotations; the paper warns that a biological sample may appear in multiple study tables and provides matchId cross-linking. Counts should not be treated automatically as unique biological specimens.

name: MicroAgroBiome
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: NAR 2026 paper describes 554 standardized crop-associated metagenomes across 28 crops and four continents, with original NCBI identifiers, taxonomic/functional data, bins/MAGs, BGCs and resistance annotations. Useful for crop/rhizosphere data discovery; agronomic outcome metadata remain limited and the resource is expanding.

name: AnimalMetaOmics
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: The 2024 paper describes metagenome, metatranscriptome, metaproteome and pangenome modules, including 55,898 microbial genomes from 581 animal species, 321 metatranscriptomic datasets and 326 metaproteomic datasets. The current portal did not load in this check, so contemporary interactive querying/download behavior remains partly unverified; it is complementary to AnimalMetagenome DB, not the same metadata archive.

name: PLaBAse
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Official query page is accessible and reports 5,565 strains with taxon search and plant-sphere/host-phenotype filters. This verifies the browsing/search entry, not bulk download; the site shows an older release and downloads remain under development. It is a strain/genome knowledgebase, not a sequencing sample archive.

name: CNGBdb Microbiome Database (MDB)
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Official help describes search by sample ID, project ID or microorganism, project/sample/Experiment-Run/assembly browsing, >170 phenotype filters and human/model-animal gene catalogs with FASTA, annotations and abundance profiles. This is CNGBdb MDB, distinct from the US MicrobiomeDB catalog; the live CNGB pages timed out during this check, so current interactive behavior and exact record coverage remain partly unverified.

name: VagDB
license_or_terms: CC-BY-4.0
notes: Downloadable DADA2-formatted vaginal 16S reference files derived from a published list of 582 human vaginal bacteria and GTDB release 207, cross-referenced to SILVA 138. It improves taxonomic assignment but contains no public-study sample or host clinical metadata.

name: Ocean Microbiomics Database (OMDB)
license_or_terms: CC-BY-4.0
notes: Official current page describes a global ocean repository with 12,347 geo-referenced samples, 274,282 reconstructed genomes and 31,058 prokaryotic species-level units, plus sequence/BGC search, interactive sampling map and supporting-data download under CC BY 4.0. This verifies documented browse/download functions, not a live query or accession join. Distinct from Ocean-M; marine context is not human host phenotype.

name: Marine Metagenomics Portal (MMP)
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Portal provides contextual genome databases: MarRef (manually curated complete marine microbial genomes), MarDB (non-complete marine genomes), MarFun (marine fungi) and SalDB (salmon-associated prokaryotes). Official page reports 120 metadata fields including environment/host, taxonomy, phenotype, pathogenicity, assembly and annotation; derived reference sets support taxonomic/functional annotation, not universal sample accession resolution.

name: Integrated Human Microbiome Database and Analysis System (Majorbio HMD)
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Official portal lists 739 amplicon studies, 228 shotgun studies and 143,314 samples; sample browsing exposes filters for body site, country, age distribution, gender, health condition, sequencing technology and platform. Useful discovery route, but no independent DOI, public API, stable release or download/license terms were found in this check; diet/lifestyle fields were not confirmed.

name: Omics Database of Fermentative Microbes (ODFM)
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: 2021 Scientific Data paper describes curated fermented-food microbial genomes, metagenomes, metataxonome and transcriptomes, downloadable sequences/annotations and BLAST/ANI functions; the paper-listed odfm.wikim.re.kr endpoint was not accessible in this check. Retained as historical food-microbe discovery context, not treated as a verified current service.

name: MicroPhenoDB
metadata_domains: microbe-disease association|body site|evidence score|core gene|virulence|antimicrobial resistance
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: 2020 paper reports 5,677 non-redundant microbe-disease phenotype associations involving 1,781 microbes and 542 conditions across 22+ body sites, plus core genes and virulence/AMR annotations. Both historical service endpoints failed during this check; no current first-party API or downloads were confirmed. Association evidence is not sample-level clinical metadata.

name: Microbiome Datahub
license_or_terms: unknown
notes: Official manual (updated 2026-03-30) supports facet-based search of shotgun metagenome BioProjects from INSD by environment, host taxon and keywords, TSV project-metadata download and API retrieval by BioProject; it also indexes MAG/RefSeq genomes and MEO environment annotations. The documented 102,174 entries are project records and 218,653 genome entries, not biological-sample counts; project/genome context must not be assigned to individual samples without mapping evidence.

name: Human Gut Microbiome Atlas
omics_types: species abundance|functional profiles|metagenomic species pan-genomes|genome-scale metabolic models
metadata_domains: age|sex|BMI|geography|disease|taxonomic abundance|functional abundance|publication and project links
license_or_terms: Check project download/citation terms; contact project for reuse questions
notes: Paper describes 6,014 public human gut shotgun metagenomic stool samples across 19 countries and 23 diseases; sampleID.csv includes age, gender, BMI and geography, and bioproj.csv lists source project references. Version 2 released 2022-10-25. Distinct from broad-habitat MicrobeAtlas and the 16S Human Microbiome Compendium.

name: Earth Microbiome Project
metadata_domains: sample type ontology|environment|habitat|geography|host context|protocol|sequence and observation tables
license_or_terms: Use source-specific dataset terms and cite EMP; inspect archive record
notes: A major curated project dataset rather than a universal archive. Metadata, mapping files, observation tables and results are distributed via Zenodo, FTP and the Qiita EMP portal; EMP and other Qiita samples can be searched by metadata/features with Redbiom. Existing data remain available; the project is not currently accepting new samples.

name: Global Microbiome Conservancy
metadata_domains: population|geography|collection|health screening|host-associated metadata|isolate and genome links
license_or_terms: Subject to participant consent, dbGaP authorization and GMC data access policy
notes: A biobank and associated public/controlled research resource, not an open metadata search portal. GMC handles metadata requests directly; sequencing data are available through dbGaP with a formal access request. Current homepage and biobank subpage report different collection counts (2,000+ and 1,500+ respectively), so do not treat either as a normalized current count.

name: Microbiota Vault
license_or_terms: Launch-phase dataset is CC BY 4.0; each local collection retains control; sequence release requires depositor request
notes: Official catalogue is accessible and lists 1,400+ samples in 9 local collections with collection/sample type and selected ENA/BioSample links, plus human/food metadata templates and SOPs. This verifies catalogue/metadata-resource availability, not universal open sequence access: sample material and sequence release remain under local depositor control and some access requires request.

name: MICROBE Data Portal

license_or_terms: See portal and linked repository terms
notes: Current official page is accessible and reports 4,353 MICROBE project samples, with API/docs entry points and links to ENA, BioSamples, MetaboLights and MGnify. The public code describes a Django API caching/unifying external metadata. This check did not call the API or confirm a complete sample crosswalk, so endpoint schema and row-level behavior remain unverified.

name: HoloFood Data Portal
metadata_domains: animal host|treatment/feed|sampling time|sample type|BioSample attributes|metagenomic and metabolomic links|taxonomy
license_or_terms: Check the terms of each linked archive and dataset
notes: The project portal reports 9,889 samples, 5 analysis summaries, 12,557 genomes and 128,888 viral sequences. API distinguishes host-animal records from derived samples and returns canonical BioSamples/ENA/MGnify/MetaboLights links. Treatment search uses animal BioSample fields such as sampling time, treatment name/description/code and concentration; useful for feed intervention studies, but not a general animal microbiome catalogue.

name: AgMicrobiomeBase

notes: The UK Crop Microbiome Cryobank paper and project portal describe crop rhizosphere/bulk-soil samples, cryobank context and links to public sequence archives. The dashboard did not render in this check, so field-level query/export is not verified. Use published accession links to return to ENA/MGnify and check current terms before reuse.

name: The Microbe Directory
metadata_domains: taxonomy|Gram stain|viral genome type|microbiome source|host|extremophile traits|microbial phenotypes
license_or_terms: See GitHub repository license and data paper
notes: Microbial feature/trait knowledgebase, not a sample archive. The 2025 paper reports manual annotations for nearly 18,000 species across bacteria, archaea, algae, fungi and viruses, covering 42 phenotypic/ecological traits; it describes a browser and downloadable data/code. The official portal URL could not be opened in this check, so current query UI and downloadable releases need follow-up.

name: Human Microbiome Bioactives Resource Portal

notes: Official portal guide documents sample facets for study, assay, race, smoking history, gender and age category; advanced queries; file facets; access type and download/cart workflow. A 2026 IBD study reports sample-level metadata, taxonomic/functional profiles and raw sequencing links in HMBR. This is a focused human gut/IBD-oriented portal, not a universal accession resolver; inspect sample-to-participant mapping and access type per record.

name: MetaSUB Reproducible Metadata
omics_types: sample metadata|sample ID crosswalks|FASTQ name mappings
accepted_ids: MetaSUB sample ID|H.A. ID|barcode|plate position|FASTQ filename
license_or_terms: The metadata repository is public; the broader MetaSUB data packet and read access may have separate access conditions. Check the repository and each linked archive record.
notes: A reproducible urban microbiome metadata repository with raw source tables, cleaned tables, and mapping files across city/sample/barcode/plate/library/FASTQ naming layers. The README reports a map_collate-generated table for 1,301 samples/FASTQs and warns many fields are incomplete. It is a project-specific worked example of ID indirection and cleaning, not a universal microbiome metadata database; some consortium data packet materials are separately access-controlled.

name: HuMMANet
omics_types: microbial species profiles|original and harmonized metabolite profiles|sample metadata|metabolite annotations
metadata_domains: disease category|sample identifiers|subject annotations|clinical covariates|time point|body site|metabolite identifiers|pathway|microbial producer
license_or_terms: Check the Zenodo record and source-study terms; source omics data are not all redistributed by HuMMANet.
notes: The 2026 resource describes 46 paired gut microbiome-metabolome studies, 59 study-units and 14,405 samples; an open Zenodo record and R/Bioconductor package provide study bundles with matched sample metadata and omics matrices. It is useful for discovering paired microbiome/metabolome cohorts and harmonized metabolite annotations, not for arbitrary public accession resolution. Verify how each source study's controlled/open data are represented; the preprint notes source datasets are not uniformly redistributed.

name: NIAID Data Ecosystem Discovery Portal

accepted_ids: search terms|disease or organism names|external dataset accessions
license_or_terms: The portal indexes metadata and links to source providers; access restrictions are defined by each source repository.
notes: Cross-repository discovery portal for infectious and immune-mediated disease data, tools and resource catalogs; current source list includes MicrobiomeDB and generalist repositories. Search results and metadata can be exported as CSV/JSON or accessed through a public API. It indexes metadata rather than hosting source datasets, its coverage is defined by participating sources, and source metadata may be incomplete or irrelevant to a microbiome-specific query; follow each source link for data access.

name: Human Long-Read Metagenomics Database
metadata_domains: sampling context|health state|body site|sequencing platform|taxonomy|function|ARG|assembly quality
license_or_terms: Free for academic use; commercial use requires contacting the resource team.
notes: Curates 1,672 public human-associated long-read or hybrid metagenomes across 38 studies; sample search exposes health/disease, sampling-context and platform terms and links samples to genome-resolved and functional results. This is a fixed curated collection, not a universal accession resolver. Academic-only free-use condition is stated on the site.

name: dbCAN-HGM
aliases: dbCAN HGM|Human Gut Microbiome CAZyme Gene Clusters
metadata_domains: diet-associated read mapping|disease-associated read mapping|taxonomy|geography|glycan substrate|functional annotation
license_or_terms: Check resource-specific terms before reusing downloaded sequence or annotation files.
notes: Catalogs 121,883 CAZyme gene clusters from 6,031 species-level representative MAGs and provides diet/disease read mapping summaries, geographic and taxonomic views, and batch downloads. Diet/disease associations are aggregated mappings to genome clusters, not a per-participant phenotype table; predicted substrates require experimental validation.

name: Deep Ocean Omics
license_or_terms: The article states that DOO data and materials are freely accessible; cite DOO and check any linked source dataset terms.
notes: Integrates multi-omics information for 68 deep-ocean animal species, including genomes, metagenomes, transcriptomes, single-cell records, microbial symbionts and gene annotations. Useful for deep-sea ecological data discovery, not human host metadata retrieval.

name: Meta-virus Resource
license_or_terms: See the database and source-data terms for reuse.
notes: Successor to IMG/VR with 24,435,662 uncultivated viral genomes from diverse metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sources, taxonomy, predicted host links, protein clusters and a documented API. Official web/API endpoints returned access errors during this check, so current interactive availability remains partial.

name: metaTraits
accepted_ids: NCBI TaxID|GTDB taxon|genome accession|SPIRE ID|JGI ID|BV-BRC ID
license_or_terms: Underlying source databases and predictions retain their respective terms; use provenance flags to distinguish observed from predicted traits.
notes: Integrates culture-derived and genome-predicted traits across more than 2.2 million genomes and 140+ harmonized traits; supports taxonomy/genome lookup, community profile annotation, downloadable summaries and an unauthenticated JSON API. The site reports scheduled maintenance during this check. These are microbial traits, not participant-level host phenotypes.

name: metagRoot
aliases: EnvoFams metagRoot|Plant Root Microbiome Protein Families
license_or_terms: Paper provides a Zenodo data deposit; review the record license and any linked source-data terms.
notes: Catalogs 71,091 plant-root-associated protein families integrating 1,199 metagenomic datasets, 327 metatranscriptomic datasets and 2,978 reference genomes, with ecological context and downloadable sequence/model data. The official portal did not load in this check; the paper links an open Zenodo deposit.

name: MicrobialScope
license_or_terms: See portal data-use terms and underlying reference-data licenses.
notes: Searches microbial genome IDs and provides genome/protein records, taxonomy and functional annotations across bacteria, archaea, fungi and viruses, plus sequence and annotation downloads and an announced flexible Download API. It is a genome knowledgebase, not a BioSample-to-host-phenotype resolver.

name: VirJenDB

license_or_terms: Verify source-specific sequence and metadata terms before reuse.

notes: Official indexed portal identifies current release v1.1.3 and search functionality; metadata documentation enumerates INSDC/BioSample/BioProject/SRA links, collection date/geography, host fields and downloadable mapping files. API/Swagger could not be parsed and was not called; no accession-level behavior verified. Host-field completeness depends on source and fields may be absent or unstandardized.

name: AMRnet
license_or_terms: Public dashboard/download; source-data and surveillance terms apply.
notes: Official data-access documentation confirms no-registration per-organism TSV downloads and weekly public S3 CSV snapshots. The REST API at api.amrnet.org requires a free registered API key; it replaces the older MongoDB Atlas Data API. This verifies documented access routes, not a live API call or downloaded snapshot. Limited to supported pathogen surveillance records, not general microbiome/host clinical metadata.

name: ARKbase
license_or_terms: Check database and source-specific reuse terms.
notes: Provides reference pathogen genomes, curated genome antimicrobial susceptibility test records, AMR/virulence annotation, genome browser and comparative analysis across priority bacterial pathogens. Its AST phenotype concerns pathogen isolates, not host microbiome sample phenotypes.

name: Iridovirus Comprehensive Database
license_or_terms: Review publication and source-data terms for downstream reuse.
notes: Provides geolocation and genomes for 310 iridovirus isolates, nonredundant proteins, core genes, evolutionary relationships, host-range information, vaccines and visual detection methods. Specialized pathogen resource, not a general microbiome sample metadata source.

name: Celeri Microbiome Studies Explorer
license_or_terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 with additional terms; prohibits full-database redistribution/mirroring and systematic scraping
notes: ENA XML is the data source; AI extracts/standardizes submitter-provided fields and does not establish recovery from papers/supplements. Human gut only. On 2026-11-11 the official page showed “No update available” and the table remained in loading state; an earlier visible last-sync date was 2026-05-28. No public API confirmed. Additional terms prohibit full-database redistribution/mirroring and systematic scraping.

name: mOTUs genome database (mOTUs-db)
license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0
notes: Genome-resolved reference and environmental distribution resource; associated sample/study context is not participant-level phenotype. Database paper reports 124,295 species-level mOTUs and 3.75 million genomes; counts are version-dependent.

name: APOLLO human microbiome metabolic reconstructions
license_or_terms: See per-model and VMH terms; article open access does not establish all model-file redistribution rights.
notes: Paper reports 247,092 microbial genome-scale reconstructions and 14,451 sample-specific community models. Useful for metabolic potential, not a general sample metadata or accession resolver; exact per-model sample crosswalk should be checked before reuse.

name: MicroMap human microbiome metabolism visualization
license_or_terms: Article CC BY 4.0; check individual Dataverse file terms.
notes: Curated network visualization of metabolic capabilities across 257,429 microbial genome-scale models; supports metabolism exploration, not sample/host metadata retrieval.

name: Mica INTIMIC metadata portal
license_or_terms: No general redistribution license confirmed; study-level metadata public, individual-level data may remain controlled at source
notes: Metadata inventory for observational nutritional epidemiology and gut microbiome studies participating in INTIMIC; links studies, variables, datasets and harmonization protocols. DataSHIELD/Opal enables federated analysis without central transfer; not a general sequencing accession index or open individual-level phenotype download. Study-level metadata does not guarantee BioSample/Run crosswalk.

metadata_domains: study design|population|dietary assessment|outcome measures|ethics|data access|record linkage|publications

notes: Cross-domain German clinical/public-health/epidemiology study metadata portal. Aggregates public registries and steward-collected records; semantic search may reach variable/item level. Nutritional epidemiology schema module includes dietary assessment information. Not microbiome-specific; after discovery, confirm assay, BioSample/Run accession and dataset access rights.
